lead_rationale: ARE-GAN performs ordinary Alzheimer disease-progression prediction by generating future MRI states and classifying progression; it is not framed as a world model, twin, or reusable dynamic simulator and is not used for model-based planning or closed-loop control.
full_text_anchor: Version-of-record Methods and Results: adaptive regression and ROI-enhanced GAN generation of future MRIs with image-similarity and disease-stage evaluation.

lead_rationale: This is conventional semi-mechanistic pharmacometric disease-progression analysis linking amyloid reduction to CDR-SB and projecting treatment trajectories; it lacks qualifying simulator or twin identity and is not an internal planning or control environment.
full_text_anchor: Version-of-record Model development and Simulations sections: Richard's-function CDR-SB progression fitted to Studies 201 and 301, amyloid-mediated treatment effect, and four-year projections.

lead_rationale: The latent-diffusion model performs individualized future-MRI generation for disease-progression forecasting, but the authors do not frame it as a world model, twin, or reusable simulator and it is not used for iterative planning or control.
full_text_anchor: Version-of-record Method and Experiments: individual-conditioned latent diffusion over longitudinal 3D MRI with future-image similarity, morphometry, and progression evaluation.

lead_rationale: Clinical-GAN is an ordinary subsequent-visit and clinical-event forecasting system; its generated trajectories are not given qualifying patient-simulator or world-model identity and do not support model-based planning or closed-loop control.
full_text_anchor: Version-of-record model and experiments: transformer generator and discriminator trained on more than 500,000 visits from about 196,000 patients and evaluated on subsequent-visit forecasting.

lead_rationale: The continuous-time hidden Markov model is a conventional Huntington disease-progression and societal-cost model; synthetic-population intervention scenarios do not by themselves establish twin, patient-simulator, or world-model identity.
full_text_anchor: Version-of-record Methods and Results: cross-validated disease-state selection, transition-rate estimation, life-expectancy correction, and population-cost simulation under hypothetical interventions.

lead_rationale: This is a general model-discovery and selection method for noisy biological systems; simulations are used to recover equations and validate inference rather than to establish a reusable biomedical simulator or a planning environment.
full_text_anchor: Version-of-record Methods and Results: neural latent-dynamics fitting, SINDy model recovery, noise stress tests, and a single-cell transcriptomic state-transition application.

lead_rationale: DiSPAH is an ordinary latent-state disease-progression model estimating pathway and speed and forecasting future ALS course; it has no qualifying simulator, twin, planning, or closed-loop-control identity.
full_text_anchor: Version-of-record Model and Results: continuous-time hidden Markov transitions, individualized speed parameters, inferred ALS pathways, and held-out future-course prediction.

lead_rationale: The spatial neural network and hybrid PINN perform conventional epidemiological forecasting and latent-susceptible reconstruction; neither is framed as a qualifying dynamic simulator nor used as an environment for planning or control.
full_text_anchor: Version-of-record Forecasting experiments: England and Wales biweekly measles incidence, multi-horizon comparisons with TSIR, and latent-susceptible reconstruction.

lead_rationale: The recurrent model performs ordinary multihorizon Alzheimer biomarker and clinical-status forecasting; it is not framed as a twin or reusable patient simulator and is not used for model-based planning or closed-loop control.
full_text_anchor: Version-of-record Methods and Experiments: joint imputation, biomarker forecasting, cognitive-trajectory estimation, and future clinical-status prediction on TADPOLE.

lead_rationale: CKD-PM is a conventional patient-level state-transition and risk model assembled from published equations; use in patient-level simulations does not give it explicit world-model, twin, or reusable patient-simulator identity.
full_text_anchor: Version-of-record Model development and Validation: KDIGO state transitions, time-dependent eGFR and complication risks, calibration, and comparison with source and external cohorts.

lead_rationale: SReFT-ML aligns fragmented observations to reconstruct a long-term diabetes disease course and associate it with outcomes; this is disease-progression estimation rather than an explicitly framed simulator or planning environment.
full_text_anchor: Version-of-record Method and Results: synthetic trajectory-recovery tests, ACCORD reconstruction, 30-year biomarker evolution, and outcome-risk associations.

lead_rationale: The fitted tumor-growth-inhibition and survival model is conventional pharmacometric disease modeling and external qualification, without qualifying twin or simulator framing and without iterative planning or control.
full_text_anchor: Version-of-record TGI and TGI-OS model-development and external-qualification sections: CONFIRM fitting with PALOMA-3 and SANDPIPER validation.

lead_rationale: EczemaPred is an ordinary personalized state-space forecasting framework for daily-to-weekly severity trajectories; it is not framed as a patient simulator or twin and is not used for planning or closed-loop control.
full_text_anchor: Version-of-record Methods and Validation: nine latent severity-item models, PO-SCORAD trajectory composition, and comparison with autoregressive baselines across two studies.

lead_rationale: The rSLDS study estimates and predicts neural dynamics, while closed-loop neuromodulation is stated only as a possible future use; the learned transition is not operationally used for planning or control and has no simulator identity.
full_text_anchor: Version-of-record rSLDS model and Evaluation sections: synthetic recovery and future-state prediction on monkey recordings; the Discussion presents closed-loop control as future work.

lead_rationale: This is conventional exposure-safety pharmacometric Markov modeling and regimen simulation; it is not framed as a world model, twin, or reusable patient simulator and is not used for iterative planning or control.
full_text_anchor: Version-of-record Model development, Model evaluation, and Model application sections: daily ocular-event transitions, exposure effects, visual predictive checks, and alternative-dose simulations.

lead_rationale: IP-DDGAN performs subject-specific longitudinal MRI forecasting and image generation, but it is not framed as a world model, twin, or reusable dynamic simulator and does not support planning or closed-loop control.
full_text_anchor: Primary preprint Method and Results: metadata-guided diffusion-GAN forecasting of longitudinal ADNI MRI with multihorizon image, identity, morphology, and phenotype evaluation.

lead_rationale: The latent neural SDE is presented as a probabilistic clinical time-series forecasting and treatment-effect framework, not as a reusable patient simulator or world model, and it is not used for iterative planning or control.
full_text_anchor: Version-of-record methods and experiments: variational latent-SDE state estimation and forecasting on simulated PK/PD, synthetic glucose, and real ICU trajectories.

lead_rationale: The hierarchical Bayesian model predicts untreated natural history for rare-disease trial analysis; it is not framed as a clinical-trial simulator or patient simulator and is not an environment for iterative planning or control.
full_text_anchor: Version-of-record Methods and Results: individual FEV1 natural-history prediction, responder definition, posterior treatment comparison, type-I-error control, and trial-power analysis.

lead_rationale: Disease Course Mapping supplies one-year prognostic scores to statistical trial estimators; the study does not present a reusable dynamic simulator, twin, or model-based planning environment.
full_text_anchor: Version-of-record Methods and Results: external natural-history training, ATRIL trial application, prognostic-score forecasting, variance comparisons, and sample-size calculations.

lead_rationale: The hybrid latent-ODE and Hill-function models reconstruct cellular dynamics and analyze gene-coupling perturbations, but the work is framed as model inference and mechanistic interpretation rather than a virtual cell, reusable simulator, or planning environment.
full_text_anchor: Primary preprint Methods and Results: six developmental time points, latent neural-ODE reconstruction, short-term prediction, mechanistic gene-regulation fitting, and in silico coupling perturbations.

lead_rationale: Dynamic causal modeling is used to infer latent psychosis trajectories and subgroup structure; the study does not frame the fitted process as a world model or reusable patient simulator and does not use it for planning or control.
full_text_anchor: Version-of-record Methods and Results: generative-embedding inversion of longitudinal psychosis data, parameter clustering, inferred disorder trajectories, and subgroup comparisons.

lead_rationale: This is conventional population dose-response and disease-progression pharmacometrics for daprodustat titration; observed-versus-simulated hemoglobin trajectories do not establish twin or patient-simulator identity.
full_text_anchor: Version-of-record Model development and Evaluation: five Phase III studies, dose-driven red-cell production dynamics, dialysis-dependent progression, titration algorithms, and visual predictive checks.

lead_rationale: NeuroVelo reconstructs cellular transitions and gene-regulatory interactions from single-cell data; it is not framed as a virtual cell or reusable dynamic simulator and is not used for planning or closed-loop control.
full_text_anchor: Version-of-record Method and Benchmark Results: optimized projection plus neural ODE, transition reconstruction, regulatory-network recovery, and comparisons with RNA-velocity methods.

lead_rationale: The Bayesian latent-process model is conventional Duchenne disease-progression analysis; potential posterior simulation for drug-development decisions does not amount to explicit trial-simulator, patient-simulator, or world-model identity.
full_text_anchor: Version-of-record Model and Results: 218 Duchenne patients plus controls, full Bayesian estimation, age-dependent rise and decline of 6MWT, and posterior simulation.

lead_rationale: The symbolic neural network learns covariate functions and Markov parameters for ordinary diabetes disease-progression prediction; it has no qualifying simulator or twin identity and no planning or control use.
full_text_anchor: Version-of-record Method and Application: joint symbolic-function and transition fitting, pruning to readable covariate relations, and predictive comparison with a manually developed model.

lead_rationale: LNODE is a fitted latent amyloid-progression model used for trajectory explanation and subtype analysis; it is not framed as a digital twin or reusable patient simulator and is not used for planning or closed-loop control.
full_text_anchor: Version-of-record Model and Results: 585 ADNI subjects, joint parameter inversion, regional normal and abnormal amyloid states, latent mechanisms, and longitudinal fit.

lead_rationale: The longitudinal item-response model is conventional exposure-outcome pharmacometrics with alternative-dose symptom simulation; it lacks qualifying twin or patient-simulator identity and iterative planning or control.
full_text_anchor: Version-of-record model and results: 4,136 symptom observations, latent impairment progression, efavirenz exposure effect, model fit, and 400-mg symptom simulations.

lead_rationale: Myo-ODE reconstructs refractive trajectories and predicts high-myopia risk; it is an ordinary progression and forecasting model rather than an explicitly framed twin or reusable simulator and is not used for planning or control.
full_text_anchor: Version-of-record Methods and Results: 4,973 longitudinal records, neural-ODE interpolation and short-term extrapolation, individualized trajectories, and risk-prediction metrics.

lead_rationale: The personalized dose-glucose model is conventional PK/PD and linear disease-progression analysis; long-term response forecasting and dose optimization do not establish a patient-simulator, twin, or planning-environment identity.
full_text_anchor: Version-of-record Model and Results: first-month gestational-diabetes data used for fitting, personalized dose-response estimation, and later glucose-trend comparison with autoregression.

lead_rationale: This is conventional population PK/PD modeling of paracetamol and ductus closure; virtual-patient dose simulations do not by themselves establish world-model, twin, or reusable patient-simulator identity.
full_text_anchor: Version-of-record Methods and Results: effect-compartment plus exponential progression model, parameter estimation in 29 neonates, and 500-patient dosing simulations.

lead_rationale: The personalized input-output HMM estimates Parkinson disease states and medication effects for prediction and interpretation; it is not framed as a patient simulator or twin and is not used for iterative model-based planning.
full_text_anchor: Primary preprint Model and Experiments: variational transition learning, subject and medication effects, synthetic recovery, and two real Parkinson datasets.

lead_rationale: PINN-EM fits patient-specific PDE coefficients for geographic-atrophy progression and extrapolation; it is not framed as a digital twin or reusable simulator and is not used for planning or closed-loop control.
full_text_anchor: Version-of-record methods and results: iterative PDE-coefficient and data fitting, PDEBench validation, OCT progression extrapolation, and Dice evaluation of newly affected areas.

lead_rationale: The multi-information GAN performs ordinary future-MRI generation and Alzheimer progression classification; it is not framed as a world model, twin, or reusable dynamic simulator and does not support planning or control.
full_text_anchor: Version-of-record experiments: ADNI baseline conditioning, future 3D MRI generation, similarity against observed year-four scans, and pMCI versus sMCI classification.

lead_rationale: The mRSS model is conventional disease-progression and treatment-effect analysis used for extrapolation and trial-power simulation; it lacks qualifying simulator or twin identity and iterative planning or control.
full_text_anchor: Version-of-record Model and Results: 24-week fitting, prediction through week 52, observed-versus-predicted extension outcomes, and simulated alternative trial designs.

lead_rationale: The continuous-time HMM identifies autoimmune disease-progression states and predicts diabetes onset; it is not framed as a patient simulator or twin and is not used for model-based planning or closed-loop control.
full_text_anchor: Version-of-record Model and Results: 24,662-participant cohort, 11 latent states, three transition pathways, covariate-refined rates, and five-year survival predictions.

lead_rationale: The variational disease-progression score framework provides latent staging, individualized prognosis, and uncertainty calibration; it has no qualifying simulator or twin identity and no planning or control use.
full_text_anchor: Primary preprint Methods and Results: ADNI multimodal biomarkers, learned latent timeline and cascade strengths, unseen-subject prognosis, dynamic updating, and credible-interval coverage.

lead_rationale: The longitudinal item-response model is ordinary PSP progression and trial-design pharmacometrics; trial simulations do not give it explicit clinical-trial-simulator, patient-simulator, or world-model identity.
full_text_anchor: Version-of-record Model and Trial simulations: 979 patients, longitudinal latent progression, item-information comparison, and simulated treatment-detection sample sizes.

lead_rationale: L1MSTATE is a statistical method for risk-factor selection and transition-probability prediction in multistate disease data; it is not a reusable simulator or twin and is not used for planning or control.
full_text_anchor: Version-of-record Method and Results: coordinate-descent fitting, simulation recovery, and EBMT transition-probability prediction against unregularized models.

lead_rationale: scMTG is framed as a single-cell transition-reconstruction and held-out-time-point generation method, not as a virtual cell or reusable dynamic simulator, and it is not used for iterative planning or closed-loop control.
full_text_anchor: Primary preprint Experiments: held-out time-point generation, transition-matrix inference, benchmark comparisons, and time-resolved regulatory-network analysis.

lead_rationale: The study applies fitted natural-history models and a trial-derived time delay to project long-term lecanemab effects; this is conventional disease-progression simulation without qualifying simulator, twin, planning, or control identity.
full_text_anchor: Version-of-record Methods and Results: ADNI and NACC progression models, Clarity AD time-delay effect, discontinuation scenarios, and years-to-severe-AD projections.

lead_rationale: The multimodal models estimate genotype-specific frontotemporal-dementia progression and support endpoint and sample-size simulations; they are not framed as patient or trial simulators and are not planning environments.
full_text_anchor: Version-of-record Disease progression modeling and Trial simulations: 796 carriers, 412 controls, genotype-specific temporal ordering, modeled patient selection, endpoints, and sample sizes.

lead_rationale: The Markov-Bayesian model generates synthetic diabetes-complication trajectories for progression inference and population-health analysis, but it is not framed as a patient simulator or twin and is not used for planning or control.
full_text_anchor: Version-of-record Methods and Results: 9,298 patients, anchor-optimized parameter learning, 5,000 generated trajectories, endocrinologist review, and complication-pattern prediction.

lead_rationale: This paper audits RNA-velocity estimation and embedding artifacts rather than presenting a world model, virtual cell, reusable dynamic simulator, or learned environment for planning or closed-loop control.
full_text_anchor: Version-of-record Results: high- and low-dimensional velocity evaluation, nearest-neighbor dependence, direction and speed errors, embedding transition probabilities, and a proposed quality measure.
